---
title: "Document Checklist for a Condo Purchase on Isla Verde"
description: "The nine documents a buyer needs before signing a condo purchase contract on Isla Verde, who issues each one and how long each takes to obtain."
pubDate: 2026-03-08
author: Isla Verde Editorial
---

**Quick answer:** nine documents, three from the seller, three from the registry and three from you.

## From the seller

Title certificate, the association debt statement and the last three years of association accounts.

## From the registry

A certified copy of the title, the building permit and the plan of the unit. Every lease longer than three years must be registered at the land registry within 30 days of signing, or the lease cannot be enforced against a new owner of the land.

## From you

Passport copy, proof of funds and a tax number issued by the island revenue office.
